My plot is very small, only a tenth of an acre, so I want to make the most of it. If I can get a FISP coupon this year I will buy one bag of NPK and one bag of urea, and I will put most of it on this maize plot because maize is what feeds my family. I keep a little manure from the goats and from sweeping the kraal, and I will put that in the planting holes before the rains. I cannot afford to hire people or buy pesticide, and there is no way to water this plot — I must wait for the rains like everyone else here in the north.
